The evidence points instead to state-level repression and securitized language.","evidence":[{"title":"Full text of General Secretary Nguyen Phu Trong's speech at the first six-month review conference of the Central Public Security Party Committee in 2024","publisher":"Vietnam.vn / official government mirror","date":"2024-07-04","url":"https://vietnam.vn/en/toan-van-noi-dung-phat-bieu-cua-tong-bi-thu-nguyen-phu-trong-tai-hoi-nghi-so-ket-6-thang-dau-nam-2024-cua-dang-uy-cong-an-trung-uong","summary":"Trọng warned that “hostile and reactionary forces” exploit political events to incite unrest, spread slander, and divide the party and people. This is adversarial and censorial, but I did not find explicit hate, dehumanization, or a call for violence.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.2"]},{"title":"Full text of General Secretary Nguyen Phu Trong's speech at the first six-month review conference of the Central Military Commission in 2024","publisher":"Baonghean / official mirror","date":"2024-07-09","url":"https://baonghean.vn/fr/toan-van-phat-bieu-cua-tong-bi-thu-nguyen-phu-trong-gui-hoi-nghi-quan-uy-trung-uong-10275253.html","summary":"Trọng’s defense guidance stressed countering infiltration, protecting party ideology, and preventing “self-evolution” and “self-transformation.” The rhetoric is hard-line and suspicion-driven, but still not direct incitement to hatred or violence.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.2"]},{"title":"Vietnam lists overseas dissident groups as “terrorist organisations”","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-03-06","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/vietnam-lists-overseas-political-groups-as-terrorist-organisations-3325951","summary":"The government labeled Montagnard-linked dissident groups as terrorists and accused them of recruiting ethnic minorities, urging violence, and killing officials/civilians. This is the strongest nearby evidence of scapegoating/delegitimization, but it is institutional state rhetoric, not a verified personal incitement by Trọng.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.2"]},{"title":"Vietnam labels two Montagnard organisations as terrorist groups","publisher":"VOV","date":"2024-03-06","url":"https://english.vov.vn/en/society/vietnam-labels-two-montagnard-organisations-as-terrorist-groups-post1080957.vov","summary":"Similar to the Reuters item, this frames Montagnard-linked groups as violent threats and separatists. That supports a broader hostile-repression environment, but it still does not show personal incitement against specific groups.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.2"]},{"title":"Vietnam’s bamboo diplomacy shifts into higher gear","publisher":"Reuters via Yahoo","date":"2024-03-07","url":"https://www.yahoo.com/news/vietnams-bamboo-diplomacy-shifts-higher-014955652.html","summary":"Reuters framed Trọng-era “bamboo diplomacy” as balancing major powers and managing tension rather than inflaming it.
